clips.title: The story
paras: A Man About a Murloc is an errand undertaken on behalf of a fisherman named Jason who is troubled by local murlocs raiding his fish. Jason sends adventurers to consult Remy "Two Times", a local eccentric harboring a deep grudge and schemes of his own against the creatures.

A local fisherman named Jason has grown fed up with murlocs raiding his catches. Knowing that Remy "Two Times" harbors a mutual hatred for the amphibians, Jason directs travelers to confer with Remy to see if he has devised any practical ways to drive them away from the waters.

Upon being approached, Remy vents his frustration that the local guards refuse to heed his persistent warnings about the murloc threat. Rather than waiting on official help, Remy prepares his own retaliatory measures against the creatures, enlisting able travelers to assist in his plans.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do.
He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.
I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.
